fact: The Mauritius Standards Bureau published MS ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (information security management systems) as a current Mauritian Standard on 21 April 2023, under technical committee MSB/TC 5 Information Technology, by General Notice No. 529 of 2023.
title: MS ISO/IEC 27001:2022+ Amd 1:2024 Information security, cybersecurity and privacy protection — Information security management systems — Requirements
